title: Asked AI to remake one of my games and it's now on Steam
author: GozmaDev
selftext:
One of my games was stuck in development hell for a year (given its size) and I asked AI to polish it and finish it, the result was amazing.

ULTRACRACK will be free to play but it will have one paid DLC for the hardcore game modes.

But before releasing, got get into that Next Fest coming around the corner, then release it immediately after.

I am VERY happy of how it turned out.

By default, it has both a "**Daily Challenge**" mode and a "**Endless**" mode.  
Some time after launch I will add a couple more game modes.

# Demo is out NOW.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4946530/ULTRACRACK/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4946530/ULTRACRACK/)

comments.author: Gebby32
comments.body: whoa! this looks really cool. Steam scares me. Just found out recently you have to put a $100 down-payment to publish any game on there. Is that true? also, curious, what tools did you use for this? I've been looking to add some effects like that to a simple puzzle game i'm working on.

replies.author: GozmaDev
replies.body: It's true, *however* they refund this value once your game reaches $1000 in revenue, which is not an easy feat regardless. This game is literally just claude and Godot, nothing else, and godot is open source which is awesome, and it's really "AI friendly", no MCP needed.

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body: this looks more like a game I'd play on my phone, I love steam and play games on my steam deck all the time, but have you considered a mobile port? or would it require a real keyboard to play the game with any skill efficiency. You nailed the juice on this one
